en: It was the CEO who made the final decision.
ipa: /ɪt wəz ðə ˌsiː iː ˈəʊ huː meɪd ðə ˈfaɪnəl dɪˈsɪʒən/
trPron: İt vöz dı si i ou hu meyd dı faynıl dizijın
collocations: it was CEO who made, cleft for subject, emphasis
synonyms: the one who, the person that
commonMistake: It was the CEO that made the decision. (acceptable but 'who' is better for people)
aiExplain: It-cleft cümlelerinde 'it is/was + vurgulanan öğe + that/who + cümlenin geri kalanı' yapısı kullanılır. Bu yapı, cümledeki belirli bir öğeyi (özne, nesne, zaman, yer) vurgulamak için kullanılır. Normalde 'The CEO made the final decision' cümlesinde özne vurgusuzdur. 'It was the CEO who made the final decision' ile 'CEO'nun karar verici olduğu' vurgulanır.

grammar: It + be + object + that + subject + verb
en: It was the prototype that the engineers tested yesterday.
tr: Mühendislerin dün test ettiği şey prototipti.
ipa: /ɪt wəz ðə ˈprəʊtətaɪp ðət ði ˌendʒɪˈnɪəz ˈtestɪd ˈjestədeɪ/
trPron: İt vöz dı proutıtayp dıt di encinırs testid yestıdey
collocations: it was prototype that engineers tested, object focus
commonMistake: It was the prototype which the engineers tested. (also correct)
aiExplain: Nesne vurgusu yapılırken 'it was + nesne + that + özne + fiil' yapısı kullanılır. Normalde 'The engineers tested the prototype yesterday' cümlesinde nesne vurgusuzdur. 'It was the prototype that the engineers tested' ile test edilen şeyin PROTOTİP olduğu vurgulanır. Teknik raporlarda ve açıklamalarda kullanılır.

grammar: It + be + time expression + that + event
en: It was in 1995 that the company first went public.
ipa: /ɪt wəz ɪn naɪnˈtiːn ˈnaɪnti faɪv ðət ðə ˈkʌmpəni fɜːst went ˈpʌblɪk/
trPron: İt vöz in nayntiin naynti fayv dıt dı kampıni först vent pablık
collocations: it was in 1995 that company went public, time focus
synonyms: the year when, the moment that
commonMistake: It was in 1995 the company first went public. (informal)
aiExplain: Zaman vurgusu yapılırken 'it was + zaman ifadesi + that + cümle' yapısı kullanılır. 'It was in 1995 that the company went public' = 'The company went public in 1995' ancak zaman vurgulanır. Tarihsel anlatılarda, şirket geçmişinde ve biyografilerde sık kullanılır.

en: It was in a small village in France that they met for the first time.
tr: İlk kez karşılaştıkları yer Fransa'da küçük bir köydü.
ipa: /ɪt wəz ɪn ə smɔːl ˈvɪlɪdʒ ɪn frɑːns ðət ðeɪ met fə ðə fɜːst taɪm/
trPron: İt vöz in ö smol vilıc in Frans dıt dey met fır dı först taym
collocations: it was in small village that they met, place focus
synonyms: the place where, the location where
commonMistake: It was in a small village in France they first met. (informal)
aiExplain: Yer vurgusu yapılırken 'it was + yer ifadesi + that + cümle' kullanılır. 'It was in a small village that they met' = 'They met in a small village' ancak 'KÜÇÜK KÖY' vurgulanır. Hikaye anlatımında, seyahat yazılarında ve romantik anlatılarda tercih edilir.

grammar: It + be + because + reason + that + result
en: It was because of the budget cuts that the project was cancelled.
tr: Projenin iptal edilmesinin nedeni bütçe kesintileriydi.
ipa: /ɪt wəz bɪˈkɒz əv ðə ˈbʌdʒɪt kʌts ðət ðə ˈprɒdʒekt wəz ˈkænsəld/
trPron: İt vöz bikoz öv dı bacıt kats dıt dı pröcekt vöz kensıld
collocations: it was because of budget cuts that project cancelled, reason focus
synonyms: the reason why, due to which
commonMistake: It was because of the budget cuts the project was cancelled. (informal)
aiExplain: Neden vurgusu yapılırken 'it was because + neden + that + sonuç' kullanılır. Bu yapı, bir olayın SEBEBİNİ vurgular. Normalde 'The project was cancelled because of budget cuts' cümlesinde sebep vurgusuzdur. Raporlarda, analizlerde ve açıklamalarda kullanılır.
